summary: Shasta County cabin on an 8 ft concrete tower, built 1931 on Sugar Loaf Mountain; staffed in the 1930s-40s, closed in 1954, listed as standing today.

notes_for_editor: The 1931 build date rests on the NHLR 'Built' field; no second source gave it directly. Web search results pointed to Girard Ridge Lookout (Shasta-Trinity, 1931) and to Washington State Sugarloaf lookouts; those are different towers and were not used. The record's material 'wood' came from the design and is not stated by any source read; the register describes only the 8 ft concrete tower. The FFLA list has a separate Tuolumne 'Sugarloaf' (enclosed tower, gone) that is not this lookout. No source read gives a current access level, so access is omitted. The staffing 'no longer staffed' is inferred from the 1954 closure clipping, which says closed and does not explicitly say never staffed again.
